release_schedule.note: The grand-ducal regulation mandates a monthly index with no fixed day-of-month specified. In practice STATEC's STATNEWS press releases (e.g. stn01-26-ipc, published 2026-01-07 for December 2025 data, which itself announced that the January 2026 index would be released 2026-02-09) show releases occurring roughly on the 7th-10th of each month for the prior month's data. Following that observed cadence, the July 2026 index was likely already released around 2026-08-07 to 2026-08-11 (right around/just before the corpus's current date of 2026-08-11), so the next not-yet-occurred release is for August 2026 data, expected in the first half of September 2026; exact day could not be confirmed because the relevant STATEC pages (statistiques.public.lu) returned 403 errors on direct fetch and no specific September 2026 date was found via search.
